content: {"summary":"A checkout request can fan out into up to nine calls to the card processor, and reducing the payments‑api retry limit by setting CPX_MAX_ATTEMPTS=1 stops this multiplier.","likely_cause":"Stacked retry attempts (three attempts in orders‑api and three in payments‑api) create a multiplier that overloads the processor, causing edge 504 responses.","confidence":"high","claims":[{"text":"One checkout can generate up to nine calls toward the processor","evidence_ids":["RB-016#0"],"quote":"That's up to nine attempts against the processor for one button press."},{"text":"Setting CPX_MAX_ATTEMPTS=1 in the payments‑api ConfigMap cuts the fan‑out","evidence_ids":["RB-016#3"],"quote":"Set `CPX_MAX_ATTEMPTS=1` in the payments-api ConfigMap and roll the Deployment."}],"next_checks":["Verify the current CPX_MAX_ATTEMPTS value in the payments‑api ConfigMap","Monitor CPX-W429 rates after applying the setting change","Observe edge 504 frequency post‑change to confirm reduction"]}
